problem.title: IMLS-SLAM KITTI Odom seq 00 full: comparison with the paper's KITTI table
problem.question: How close is the IMLS-SLAM reimplementation to the paper's per-sequence KITTI Odometry translational error (official RTE), with the harness profile and with the paper's own odometry pipeline?

variants.label: IMLS-SLAM, dense profile
variants.intent: Profile used for the repository's KITTI full-sequence runs (see the method README).

variants.label: IMLS-SLAM paper odometry, window of 100 raw scans, 0.22 deg beam correction
variants.intent: The paper's pipeline and KITTI settings (Sec. V-VI): raw scans with the 0.22 deg vertical-angle correction, the last 100 localized raw scans as the model, h = 0.06 m, r = 0.20 m with a per-query normal, nine planarity-weighted lists of 100 samples walked with the r gate, 20 iterations.

variants.label: IMLS-SLAM paper odometry, window of 10 raw scans, 0.22 deg beam correction
variants.intent: As paper_odometry_w100 with the last 10 scans (the paper's Table IV puts n = 10 within 0.01 % of n = 100); about 1.6x faster.

variants.label: IMLS-SLAM paper odometry, window 10, no beam correction
IMLS-SLAM paper odometry, window 100, coarse start on the first registration
variants.intent: As paper_odometry_w100, plus one coarse stage (r = 1.0 m, h = 0.3 m, 10 iterations) before the paper's iterations on the first registration only, where the constant-velocity guess is zero. Not in the paper; it matters only for sequences that start in motion (KITTI 04: 11.9 -> 0.43 %).
